attchmntText: AVRO INDIA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Utilisation of Funds
voiceSummary: Avro India Limited confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds raised through the preferential issue of warrants for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The usage aligns with the objects stated in the explanatory statement to the Notice of the Extra Ordinary General Meeting dated 28th August 2024. A Nil statement of deviation, reviewed by the Audit Committee, is submitted for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The statement was signed by Sushil Kumar Aggarwal, Chairman and Whole Time Director, with DIN 00248707.

attchmntText: AVRO INDIA LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Avro India Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 21845 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 14603 lakhs. For the half year, revenue was 234875 lakhs, and profit before tax was 2128 lakhs. The company executed a stock split, reducing the face value of equity shares from 10 rupees to 1 rupee, effective May 5, 2026. Warrants issued to the promoter group lapsed, resulting in the forfeiture of 15000 lakhs. Warrants issued to the non-promoter group partially converted, with 1,06,090 pre-split shares allotted, while the remaining warrants lapsed, leading to the forfeiture of 13500 lakhs. A total of 28500 lakhs was transferred to Capital Reserve. The statutory auditors have issued limited review reports on these results.
